content: He who will not economize will have to agonize.
author: Confucius
explanation: Frugality is not stinginess; it is the strategic preservation of resource sovereignty. Careless dissipation of money, energy, or attention inevitably produces acute crisis and dependency.
practicalInsight: Audit your recurring subscriptions and energy drains today, eliminating one unnecessary leak of resources.
reflectionPrompt: In what resource—time, energy, or money—are you failing to economize, setting yourself up for future agony?
